elements.requirement: A person must have an item in their custody or under their control.
elements.quote: has anything in his custody or under his control

elements.requirement: A person who has an item in their custody or control must intend without lawful excuse to use it, or to cause or permit another person to use it, for a prohibited purpose.
elements.quote: intending without lawful excuse to use it or cause or permit another to use it

elements.requirement: A prohibited purpose includes intending to destroy or damage any property that belongs to another person.
elements.quote: to destroy or damage any property belonging to some other person

elements.requirement: A prohibited purpose includes intending to destroy or damage the person's own property or the user’s property in a manner that the person knows is likely to endanger the life of another person.
elements.quote: to destroy or damage his own or the user’s property in a way which he knows is likely to endanger the life of some other person

elements.requirement: A person who has custody or control of an item with the requisite unlawful intent is guilty of an offence.
elements.quote: shall be guilty of an offence
